crossRefs.note: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua…
Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”
Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.
For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
translations.bsb: When Jacob woke up, he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
translations.kjv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew
translations.asv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely Jehovah is in this place. And I knew it not.
